children: GOOG launched a private-preview Gemini agent on Google Cloud: an AI assistant that plans and executes tasks across Workspace apps, integrates with enterprise platforms, and delegates to sub‑agents.
Wells Fargo raised GOOG target to $417 from $411 and forecasts Google TPU external sales of $9.2B in Q3 and $11.5B in Q4, signaling higher TPU revenue expectations.
GOOG signed power deals with Constellation for 3,590 MW to back AI and cloud: a 20‑year 890 MW new nuclear upgrade and a 15‑year 2,700 MW supply; first upgrade due 2028; $4.3B+ planned investment.
GOOG will host Unity’s next-gen AI tools on Google Cloud, absorbing AI infra costs while Unity keeps subscription and engine fees; expands Google Cloud access to Unity developers.
Prisjakt’s unit sued Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOG) in Stockholm, seeking ~SEK 21.4 billion in damages over Google Shopping infringement; recoverable amount depends on court ruling or settlement.
GOOG is shifting from capital‑light growth to heavier asset and capex footing as AI spending rises, altering its cost structure and capital intensity.
GOOG has traded in a multi-month range with no confirmed breakout. Traders watch the top-of-range level as the key breakout trigger; note cites supportive fundamentals and enterprise AI adoption.
ARK sold 25,342 GOOG shares (~$8.74M), trimming its Alphabet Inc. Class C holding; part of larger dispositions across tech names totaling about $36.96M.
GOOG: Google Cloud extended its partnership with CaixaBank through 2033 to boost the bank’s AI and data capabilities.
GOOG fell about 0.7% to $347.94 on Oct. 9. The stock trades roughly 37% above its GF Value. Report notes a power-supply deal tied to Google’s AI and cloud buildout.
